The densest arrangement satisfying the disjoint‑boundary condition places each unit‑square hole surrounded by a 3 × 3 block of polyomino squares, i.e. one hole uses eight surrounding squares. Hence at most eight polyomino cells are needed per hole, giving an asymptotic upper bound \(h_n \le n/8\). This bound is achievable by tiling the plane with such 3 × 3 blocks, so  

\[
\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{h_n}{n}= \frac{1}{8}.
\]

**ANSWER: 1/8**
